answer: Renewing a plume needs three judgments of that identity's work, and only identities whose own work clients paid for may judge, so clones can never judge each other. Each judge serves one claim an epoch, so spare judgment capacity is finite; the forge reserves it for claims clients paid for and sells the rest to unbacked claims, one slot at a time, each dearer than the last, whatever wallet buys it. One clone buys three slots for six nectar; a thousand clones need three thousand slots, the last three costing three thousand apiece.
